title: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL on four Sparks
evidence_scope: DFlash5 draft, MXFP8 MoE and safetensors draft loader on installer image dev-20260925-qwendecode-cuda1342-nccl2323-status031: one installation through `sparkring install` on a four-Spark ring, adopting the checkpoint copies on the Sparks, passed counting, arithmetic and code checks (performance/records/images/dev-20260925-qwendecode-installer-profiles-20260926.md); single-run timing; not serving-qualified. Image dev-20260927-b12xcache-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032 is dev-20260927-h2dstaging-cuda1342-nccl2323-status031 with a B12X selection-cache correction, so starts on several Sparks reuse the kernel tuning the ranks have already agreed on, and runtime-status 0.3.2, whose dashboard shows the served model name; the installation evidence above was measured on dev-20260925-qwendecode-cuda1342-nccl2323-status031. On image dev-20260927-b12xcache-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032, containers derived from an installation of the profile that differed only in NCCL_IB_EXTENDED_IPV4_GIDS prefilled 8K to 128K-token prompts 11-17% faster with it on, which the profile sets, at an unchanged decode step rate; an installation of the profile then decoded 48.5 / 189 / 336 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 and prefilled a 64K-token prompt at 4,064 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20260927-b12xcache-mimo-v26-20260927.md). This profile runs image dev-20260927-mimovision-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032, which is dev-20260927-b12xcache-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032 with the MiMo vision encoder's attention sinks applied in the softmax denominator.
